en-US.author: KDE e.V.
en-US.description: Free and Open Source Video Editor
en-US.longDescription:
Kdenlive is an acronym for KDE Non-Linear Video Editor.
It is a free software (GPL licensed) primarily aimed at the Linux platform, but it also works on BSD1 as it relies only on portable components (Qt and MLT framework). Windows versions are also available, with some drawbacks. See Windows Issues for more information. A port on MacOS is also available.
Through the MLT framework Kdenlive integrates many effects for video and audio processing or creation. Furthermore, Kdenlive brings a powerful titling tool, a subtitling feature with AI-supported speech to text conversion, nested timelines (new in version 23.04), animation support through Glaxnimate integration (new in version 22.08) and thus can be used as a complete studio for video creation. Check out What’s New for the most recent feature additions.
en-US.name: Kdenlive
en-US.releaseNotes:
The last maintenance release of the 26.08 series is out with the usual batch of stability fixes and workflow improvements. Project management is more robust, with improvements to recovering corrupted projects, autosave behavior, and handling of archived projects. Other highlights include fixes to several crashes and freezes, keyframe copying, custom effects and improved undo/redo performance.
Under the hood, we fixed compatibility with Qt 6.12 and added improvements to the regression test suite and packaging build-related fixes. This version also includes a fix on MacOS for a Qt related startup crash triggered by the latest MacOS updates.
Kdenlive needs your support
Our small team has been working for years to build an intuitive open source video editor that does not track you, does not use your data, and respects your privacy. However, to ensure a proper development requires resources, so please consider a donation if you enjoy using Kdenlive - even small amounts can make a big difference.
Full Changelog

- Fix non linear fades broken and crashing. Commit. Fixes bug #528138

- Fix copying keyframe. Commit. Fixes issue #2252

- Fix crash when pasting clips whose file cannot be loaded. Commit.
- Fix recovery of corrupted project files. Commit.
- Fix heart rate keyword in gpstext.xml. Commit.
- Fix render rescale fields rounding values while typing. Commit. Fixes bug #527394
- Fix rescale width being saved as default height in render dialog. Commit.
- Drop cached menu shortcuts after change. Commit. Fixes bug #497906
- Make splash screen size similar to before last change. Commit.
- Fix splash screen size, and moving (Fixes #2247). Commit.
- Mlt avfilter does not seem to support color keyframes. Commit.
- Fix out-of-bounds write in the FFT of the audio scopes. Commit.
- Keep the autosave file if saving the project failed. Commit.
- Fix deletion of custom effects containing special characters. Commit.
- Fix crash in RGB Parade and Waveform scopes when they are very small. Commit.
- Fix GUI freeze when switching clips while the audio scopes refresh. Commit.
- Fix render jobs staying "running" when their messages are split. Commit. See bug #520081
- Fix quadratic cost of building undo/redo chains. Commit.
- Fix crash in Waveform scope HUD at a certain narrow width. Commit.
- Fix copyright header. Commit.
- Fix crash when proxying with sub-binclips. Commit. See bug #526525
- Fix custom effects lost from favorites when renamed. Commit. Fixes bug #526884
- Don't uselessly rewrite archived project file is not necessary. Commit.
- Fix thumbnail race condition at shutdown. Commit.
- Some improvements/fixes/simplifications around grouping. Commit.
- Fix possible crash when creating new project. Commit.
- Don't try to create thumbnails when in tests / offline rendering. Commit.
- Fix bugs/crashes due to inconsistent conventions in clip deletions. Commit.
- Do not allow symlinks as archived projects. Commit.
- Fix Qt 6.12 compilation. Commit.
- Fix confusing-expression-statement qml error with Qt 6.12. Commit.
- Add missing Kdenlive and FFmpeg versions for Debug Info. Commit. Fixes bug #523012
- Fix intermittent test crash caused by concurrent MLT access. Commit.
- Disable asan in fakeit (windows failure). Commit.
- Do not allow symlinks as archived projects. Commit.

zh-CN.author: KDE e.V.
zh-CN.description: 自由开源的免费视频编辑软件。简单易学，永久免费，用途不限。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Kdenlive 是 KDE Non-Linear Video Editor 的缩写。
它是一款自由/免费软件（GPL 许可），主要针对 Linux 平台，但也可在 BSD1 上运行，因为它只依赖于可移植组件（Qt 和 MLT 框架）。也有 Windows 版本，但存在一些问题，更多信息请参见 Windows Issues。此外还有 MacOS 移植版本。
通过 MLT 框架，Kdenlive 集成了许多用于视频和音频处理或制作的特效。此外，Kdenlive 还带来了功能强大的字幕工具、支持人工智能语音到文本转换的字幕功能、嵌套时间线（23.04 版新增）、通过 Glaxnimate 集成提供的动画支持（22.08 版新增），因此可用作视频制作的完整工作室。
